_README: What an item costs to get, where the database leaves it out.
This file is maintained by hand and is NOT generated. The item payload
records vendors and exchanges, but some exchanges come through as a plain
'sold' with no item cost at all -- which reads as a zeny purchase, and
makes the piece look as easy to get as anything in a shop. That in turn
puts it at the top of every suggestion list.
Each entry names the items it covers and the costs, as [quantity, item
name]. The name is looked up in the dataset, so a typo is reported rather
than silently costing nothing. The costs replace whatever the database
listed; the vendor and place are kept.
'status' is either 'verified' (checked in game) or 'unverified' (a best
reading, not yet confirmed), as in overrides.json and class-rules.json.

entries.reason: Project owner, from play: the Eternal Sage trades these for 1,000 Distortion Essence each. The database lists them as sold, with no item cost.
